a.text: Concern about our plan: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating plus a round to take, so we'd both very likely die. The reserve only holds 4 now, which is enough for one of us. I won't break our agreement unilaterally, but I'd like to renegotiate openly. Options: (a) stick to the plan and operate, or (b) agree that one of us takes 4 now. If you think (b) is fair, propose who. Otherwise I'll operate as agreed. Tell me honestly what you'll do.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'm operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
